prompt:
precise-object-edit. Produce one clean 3-by-3 gaze atlas from the supplied exact 1536x840 nearest-neighbor reference grid. Every cell must remain a complete 64x35 NPC079 upper portrait at the same scale, with no labels, gutters, borders or extra padding. Row-major cells: UP-LEFT, UP, UP-RIGHT; LEFT, CENTER, RIGHT; DOWN-LEFT, DOWN, DOWN-RIGHT.

Only move the existing tiny iris-and-pupil clusters inside the two eyes. Use the center cell as the exact color, shape, size and pixel-count master. NPC079 has compact olive-gold irises with dark pupils. Keep this exact olive-gold palette and the same narrow, hooded eye openings. Do not brighten, saturate, enlarge, round or repaint the clusters. Keep the face, skin, hair, brows, lower lids, expression, lighting and background unchanged. No large whites or new highlights.

Make vertical gaze unmistakable at native 64x35 resolution: in every TOP cell, move the complete iris/pupil cluster exactly one native pixel UP from its matching middle-row cell; in every BOTTOM cell, move the complete cluster exactly one native pixel DOWN from its matching middle-row cell. The cluster must visibly occupy different native pixel rows: center iris/pupil spans approximately y26-27, UP spans y25-26, DOWN spans y27-28. Do not leave the iris and pupil on y26-27 for all three rows. The pupil and olive-gold iris move together; do not simulate a vertical glance by changing only the lid, brow, skin, highlight or color. Keep brows fixed. An upper lid may follow the UP or DOWN cluster by at most one native pixel only where needed to keep the same iris recognizable; never hide or darken a stationary cluster. Keep the lower lids fixed.

Keep clear horizontal glances too: LEFT shifts both clusters two native pixels left, CENTER has no horizontal shift, RIGHT shifts two native pixels right. Apply the same horizontal offset to all rows. Diagonals combine the row's required vertical offset with the column's horizontal offset. Both eyes must agree. Preserve chunky nearest-neighbor pixels and exact overall face proportions. Return only the 3x3 atlas.
